## Progress

- Needs MDV-P0-011

## Description

An admin invites a person by email or mobile with a role and facility scope. The invitee opens /invite/:token, sees "Join {clinic} … invited you as {Role}", the capability list (✓ allowed / ✕ not allowed, e.g. reception cannot see clinical notes), facility scope and hours, then creates a passkey (or MFA) and joins. Membership moves invited → active. Expired or reused tokens show "Ask your admin to resend".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Invitation tokens are single-use, random (≥128 bits), expire after the configured period (default 7 days) and are stored hashed.
- [ ] **AC2.** The acceptance screen shows role, facility scope and capability list exactly as derived from the role-permission matrix.
- [ ] **AC3.** After acceptance the membership is active and the user lands on the role's home route.
- [ ] **AC4.** An expired, revoked or already-used token shows the expired state and creates no membership.
- [ ] **AC5.** Invites and acceptances are audited; the invite email/SMS contains no patient data.
- [ ] **AC6.** Clinician invites are flagged "licence verification required" (verification itself ships in P1, MDV-P1-007).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
